blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: LLM-based agents accumulate extensive interaction histories when solving complex, long-horizon tasks, making efficient memory management critical to their performance and scalability. While existing memory management methods primarily focus on what to retain or retrieve, they often overlook how much perceptual detail should be allocated to individual past interactions. We posit that effective agent memory depends not only on the information preserved, but also on the granularity at which each past interaction is perceived. Motivated by this insight, we propose Resolution as Attention (RAA), a memory perception mechanism that uses visual resolution as a means of attention allocation across interaction histories. RAA renders past interactions as images and dynamically adjusts their resolution at every step according to their relevance to the agent's upcoming decision, preserving fine-grained information for critical interactions while reducing visual-token consumption for less relevant ones. To adaptively determine the perceptual fidelity of each interaction, we train a lightweight relevance estimator with teacher-model guidance and further optimize it to preserve the agent's decision consistency at a reduced visual-token cost. Experiments across multiple tasks and backbones show that RAA reduces token consumption by over 50% without compromising task performance. Moreover, RAA can be integrated as a plug-in perception layer with existing memory management methods, yielding further token savings and revealing adaptive perception as a complementary dimension of agent memory.
blocks.zh: 基于LLM的代理在解决复杂,长视距的任务时积累了广泛的交互历史,使得高效的内存管理对其性能和可扩展性至关重要. 虽然现有的内存管理方法主要侧重于保留或检索哪些内容,但它们往往忽略了应分配给过去个人互动的多少认知细节。 我们认为,有效的代理记忆不仅取决于所保存的信息,还取决于对过去每次互动的看法。 基于这种见解,我们提议将“决议”作为“关注”(RAA),这是一种记忆感知机制,它利用视觉分辨率作为在互动历史中分配注意力的手段。 RAA将过去的相互作用作为图像,并根据其与代理商即将作出的决定的相关性,在每一个步骤上动态调整其分辨率,为关键相互作用保留精细信息,同时减少不太相关的可视化的消耗。 为了适应性地确定每一次互动的感知忠实性,我们用教师模型指导来训练一个轻量级相关估计器,并进一步优化它,以降低可视化成本来保持代理商的决定一致性. 跨越多个任务和主干线的实验表明RAA在不损害任务性能的情况下将象征性消费减少50%以上. 此外,RAA可以作为插件感知层与现有的内存管理方法整合,产生更多的象征性节约,并揭示适应感知是代理记忆的一个互补维度.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
LLM-based agents have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in long-horizon tasks that unfold over multiple rounds of interactions [ 42 , 21 , 9 , 30 , 29 ] .
Reaching beyond single-pass answer generation, they autonomously complete complex tasks that once required sustained human effort, such as software engineering [ 40 , 32 ] , web research [ 47 , 12 ] , and computer use [ 37 , 18 ] .
Crucial to this success is agent memory , which condenses the ever-growing interaction history into a compact context and thereby enables agents to carry their experience across long horizons coherently [ 46 , 6 ] .
blocks.zh:
基于LLM的物剂在通过多轮相互作用展开的长视距任务中表现出了显著的能力[42、21、9、30、29]。
他们超越了单通接答生成,自主地完成了曾经需要持续人力努力的复杂任务,如软件工程[40,32],网络研究[47,12],计算机使用[37,18]等.
这一成功的关键在于代理记忆,它将不断增长的互动历史凝结成一个紧凑的背景,从而使代理能够一致地将经验带入远方。

blocks.en:
Given that protracted interactions easily inflate the LLM’s context, condensing the history into a concise representation has become a critical challenge for agent memory, with retrieval and compression emerging as the two predominant approaches.
As shown in Fig. 1 (a), retrieval stores the history in external memory and recalls relevant episodes when needed [ 16 , 3 , 38 , 48 ] .
Despite their effectiveness, these methods are fundamentally bounded by the quality of the retrieved context, as any episode left unrecalled is withheld from the agent [ 39 , 44 ] .
As shown in Fig. 1 (b), compression , on the other hand, condenses the accumulated history into a compact form, often through summarization [ 36 , 10 ] or pruning [ 13 , 17 ] .
While keeping the context concise, compression irreversibly abstracts away fine-grained information, which can be critical to subsequent decisions [ 13 ] .
Recent advances in optical context compression further explore replacing textual content with images, which can be read through fewer visual tokens, as shown in Fig. 1 (b) [ 34 , 35 , 2 , 4 ] .
While achieving substantial compression gains, these methods typically compress the history at a uniform rate or according to a fixed policy [ 4 , 23 , 11 , 25 ] .
Such uniformity leads to a waste of visual tokens on irrelevant interactions, or insufficient detail for critical ones, which hinders the agent’s performance.
blocks.zh:
鉴于长期互动容易扩大LLM的背景,将历史压缩成简洁的表述已成为代理记忆的关键挑战,检索和压缩是两个主要方法。
如图1(a)所示,检索将历史存储在外部记忆中,并在需要时回顾相关事件[16、3、38、48]。
尽管这些方法是有效的,但这些方法从根本上以检索到的上下文的质量为界限,因为任何未回顾的插曲都不得向代理商[39,44].
如图1(b)所显示,压缩则将所积累的历史收缩为紧凑的形式,往往通过归纳[36,10]或打出[13,17].
在保持上下文简洁的同时,压缩不可逆地将精细信息摘要取出,这对后期判决可能至关重要. [13].
如图1 (b) [34、35、2、4]所示,最近光学上下文压缩方面的进展进一步探索用图像取代文字内容,通过较少的视觉符号可以读取。
这些方法在取得大幅度压缩收益的同时,通常以统一的速度或根据固定政策[4、23、11、25]压缩历史。
这种统一性导致将视觉标志浪费在无关的相互作用上,或使关键因素的细节不足,从而妨碍代理人的表现。

blocks.en:
We posit that the effectiveness of agent memory depends on the granularity at which each past interaction is perceived by the agent, and that this granularity should vary across interactions and evolve as the task progresses.
Building on this insight, we propose Resolution as Attention (RAA) , a memory perception mechanism that imposes attention on each past interaction by controlling the resolution at which it is read.
Inspired by human vision, in which attention is allocated through the precision of visual perception [ 43 ] , Resolution as Attention renders each past interaction as an image and scales its resolution according to its relevance to the upcoming decision.
By dynamically calibrating the resolution of each past interaction, RAA efficiently reduces token consumption while preserving the agent’s performance.
To make RAA compatible with off-the-shelf agents, we decouple resolution allocation from the agent itself.
The resolution is decided by a lightweight module before the agent perceives the memory, and is realized purely by resizing images rendered from the original textual content.
The agent therefore requires no additional training to control the perception process, allowing RAA to be plugged into vision-capable agents as a perception layer.
blocks.zh:
我们假设,代理记忆的有效性取决于代理人对过去每次相互作用的感知的颗粒性,这种颗粒性应当因相互作用而有差异并随着任务的进展而演变.
基于这一见解,我们提出决议作为注意(RAA),这是一个记忆感知机制,通过控制其读取的决议,将注意力强加给过去的每一次互动。
受人视觉的启发,通过视觉感知的精准度分配注意力[43],"分辨率作为关注"(Resolution as Release)使过去的每一次互动都成为了形象并根据其与即将做出的决定的相关性来衡量其分辨率.
RAA通过动态地校正过去每次互动的解析度,在保持代理商性能的同时高效地减少象征性消费.
为了使RAA与现成的代理兼容,我们从代理本身中解析分辨率分配.
分辨率由代理器在感知到内存之前的轻量级模块决定,并且纯粹通过重新调整从原始文本内容所渲染出图像的大小来实现.
因此,该剂不需要额外的训练来控制感知过程,允许RAA被插入可视能剂作为感知层.

blocks.en:
We instantiate Resolution as Attention with a lightweight relevance estimator fine-tuned from Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B [ 45 ] , which judges the relevance of each past interaction to the upcoming decision given the task and the latest interaction.
A learnable normalized sigmoid mapping then translates this relevance into the resolution at which each interaction is perceived.
We train RAA in two stages.
In the first stage, the relevance estimator is fine-tuned to match the relevance scores assigned by a teacher model on high-scoring trajectories.
In the second stage, the estimator and the mapping are jointly calibrated with reinforcement learning, which rewards preserving the agent’s original decisions with fewer visual tokens.
The agent itself remains frozen during both stages, allowing RAA to be trained once and transferred to other agents without further fine-tuning.
Experiments on ClawGym-Bench [ 1 ] show that RAA reduces history token consumption by up to 57.5% across all three agents [ 20 , 19 , 26 ] , two of which are unseen during training.
It consistently maintains comparable task performance and achieves the lowest tokens per task among all baselines.
We also demonstrate that RAA , serving as a memory perception layer, generalizes across existing memory management methods [ 10 , 38 , 13 ] , further reducing their token consumption by up to 54.1% while preserving task performance.
Our main contributions are summarized as follows: • We introduce memory perception as a dimension of agent memory, complementary to retrieval and compression, dictating the granularity at which each past interaction is perceived. We realize efficient memory perception through Resolution as Attention , which casts the agent’s attention over its memory as image resolution. To the best of our knowledge, our approach is the first to allocate perceptual attention across past interactions according to their evolving relevance to the upcoming decision. • We design Resolution as Attention as a lightweight perception layer, comprising a relevance estimator and a normalized sigmoid mapping. Orthogonal to both the agent and its underlying memory, RAA transfers to unseen off-the-shelf agents and composes with existing memory management methods without additional fine-tuning. • Extensive experiments on ClawGym-Bench with Qwen-3.8-27B [ 20 ] , Qwen-3.6-27B [ 19 ] , and Kimi-K3 [ 26 ] show that Resolution as Attention substantially reduces token consumption while preserving task performance, outperforming all baselines. Ablations and analyses further validate the effectiveness of each component and training stage, as well as the generalization of Resolution as Attention to existing memory management methods.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Leveraging the reasoning and tool-use capabilities of LLMs, LLM agents have advanced to tackling complex tasks through iterative interaction with external environments [ 42 , 21 , 30 ] .
Recent efforts have explored the use of agents in software engineering [ 40 , 32 ] , web research [ 47 , 12 ] , and computer use [ 37 , 18 ] , where tasks typically unfold over extended sequences of interactions.
These interactions generate an expanding history of reasoning, actions, and observations that informs subsequent decisions.
The input context thus grows with the interaction horizon, making memory management a central challenge for long-horizon LLM agents [ 46 , 6 ] .
blocks.zh:
利用LLM的推理和工具使用能力,LLM代理人通过与外部环境的迭接互动,在解决复杂任务上取得了进展[42、21、30]。
最近的努力探索了在软件工程[40,32],网络研究[47,12],以及计算机使用[37,18]中使用代理商的问题,这些代理商的任务通常在扩展的相互作用序列中展开.
这些互动产生了一个不断扩大的推理、行动和观察历史,为随后的决定提供依据。
因此,投入背景随着互动视野而增长,使记忆管理成为长视LLM代理[46,6]的中心挑战.

blocks.en:
Given the finite context window of LLMs, various approaches have been proposed to manage agent memory [ 46 , 6 ] .
These methods primarily follow two paradigms, namely retrieval and compression .
Retrieval-based methods store past interactions in an external memory and recall relevant episodes into the context on demand.
MemGPT [ 16 ] organizes memory into an operating-system-like hierarchy, while Mem0 [ 3 ] and A-MEM [ 38 ] store memory as interconnected nodes.
Their effectiveness, however, hinges on the retrieval quality, as episodes that are unrecalled remain invisible to the agent [ 39 , 44 ] .
Compression-based methods instead condense the interaction history into a compact representation.
ACON [ 10 ] and ReSum [ 36 ] periodically summarize the history, while observation masking [ 13 ] and LLMLingua-style [ 7 , 17 , 8 ] methods prune earlier history.
However, these methods irreversibly discard fine-grained information that may be critical to subsequent decisions [ 13 ] . Retrieval and compression determine which content is recalled or retained, whereas Resolution as Attention adjusts the granularity at which the memory is perceived.
blocks.zh:
鉴于有限背景窗口有限,提出了各种管理代理内存的办法[46、6]。
这些方法主要遵循两个范式,即检索和压缩.
基于检索的方法将过去的相互作用存储在外部内存中,并根据需要将相关事件召回上下文.
MemGPT [16] 将内存组织成类似操作系统的层次,而Mem0 [3]和A-MEM [38] 存储内存作为互联节点.
然而,其有效性取决于检索的质量,因为未经回顾的事件对代理人来说仍然是看不见的[39、44]。
以压缩为主的方法反而将交互历史收缩为紧凑的表示.
ACON [10]和ReSum [36] 定期总结历史,而观察遮掩 [13] 和 LLMLingua 风格 [7, 17, 8] 方法 prune更早的历史.
然而,这些方法不可逆转地抛弃了可能对于以后的决定至关重要的精细信息[13]. 检索和压缩决定了哪些内容被召回或保留,而作为注意的解析度则会调整感知内存的颗粒性.

blocks.en:
In recent research, optical context compression has emerged as a promising direction for long-context compression.
Utilizing the Optical Character Recognition (OCR) capabilities of vision-language models, it renders text into images that can be read through fewer visual tokens.
DeepSeek-OCR [ 34 , 35 ] and Glyph [ 2 ] show that text can be decoded from rendered images at substantial compression ratios.
AgentOCR [ 4 ] extends this to agent memory, training the agent to control the compression rate and read from the rendered image.
MemOCR [ 23 ] trains a model to rewrite its memory into rich text that emphasizes crucial information through layout.
OCR-Memory [ 11 ] and VERA [ 25 ] further explore downsampling older interactions by recency.
However, these methods either compress the memory at a uniform rate or by a fixed recency policy. Resolution as Attention instead treats memory reading as perception, using image resolution as a means to control the granularity at which each past interaction is perceived.
This perceptual perspective opens a dimension of agent memory orthogonal to existing retrieval and compression methods by making memory reading interaction-wise, decision-aware, and non-destructive.
blocks.zh:
在最近的研究中,光学上下文压缩逐渐成为长文本压缩的有希望的方向.
它利用视觉语言模型的光学字符识别(OCR)能力,使文本变成可以通过较少的视觉符号读取的图像.
DeepSeek-OCR [34,35]和Glyph [2] 显示,文本可以以实质性压缩比率从所渲染的图像中解码.
AgentOCR [4] 将此扩展至代理内存,训练代理控制压缩速率,并从渲染的图像读取.
MemOCR [23] 训练出一种模式来将记忆重写为丰富文本,通过布局强调关键信息.
OCR-Memory [11]和VERA [25] 进一步探索通过复用来降低更古老的相互作用.
然而,这些方法要么以统一的速度来压缩内存,要么采用固定的复健政策. 分辨率取而代之的是将内存读取作为感知,将图像分辨率用作控制每个过去互动的颗粒性的手段.
这种感知视角通过使内存读取交互性,决策感知性和无损性,开启了代理内存正向性到现有检索和压缩方法的维度.

blocks.en: 3 Preliminaries
blocks.zh: 3 序言

blocks.en: We first formalize the long-horizon agent setting in which the interaction history accumulates over time ( Sec. 3.1 ), then introduce text-rendered memory, where the resolution of each image determines its perceptual fidelity ( Sec. 3.2 ).

blocks.en: 4 Resolution as Attention
blocks.zh: 4 作为关注的决议

blocks.en:
We now introduce Resolution as Attention , a memory perception mechanism that imposes attention on each past interaction by controlling the resolution at which it is read.
We first present the overall framework ( Sec. 4.1 ).
As shown in Fig. 2 , Resolution as Attention estimates the relevance of each past interaction to the upcoming decision ( Sec. 4.2 ), maps the relevance to a resolution scale, and resizes the canonical images of the past interactions at these scales to form the memory that the agent perceives ( Sec. 4.3 ).
Finally, we describe our two-stage training procedure that learns the relevance estimator and the resolution mapping while keeping the agent intact ( Sec. 4.4 ).

最后,我们描述了我们两个阶段的培训程序,它学习了相关性估计和分辨率绘图,同时保持剂完好无损(第4.4节)。

blocks.en:
Resolution as Attention does not impose a global token budget constraint on perception, unlike the softmax in attention, which distributes a fixed total weight across keys.
Before the memory is perceived, the amount of information required by the upcoming decision remains unknown, so a preset budget may either truncate critical details or retain redundant ones.
We therefore scale each interaction independently according to its relevance score, allowing the total visual tokens to vary with the demand of each decision.

在发现内存之前,即将作出的决定所要求的信息数量仍然不明,因此预先设定的预算可能缩短关键细节或保留冗余细节.
因此,我们根据每个互动的关联性得分,独立地进行规模化,使总的视觉符号随每个决定的要求而变化.

blocks.en: 4.2 Relevance Estimation

blocks.en:
The relevance estimator f θ f_{\theta} anticipates the relevance of each past interaction to the upcoming decision.
Concretely, we instantiate f θ f_{\theta} as a lightweight reranker, which takes the task description D D and the latest interaction h t − 1 h_{t-1} as the query and scores each past interaction against the query.
The relevance is given by the probability of an affirmative judgment: p i ( t ) = σ ⁡ ( z yes − z no ) , p_{i}^{(t)}=\sigma\big(z_{\text{yes}}-z_{\text{no}}\big), (8) where z yes z_{\text{yes}} and z no z_{\text{no}} are the logits of the tokens “yes” and “no”, respectively, and σ \sigma denotes the sigmoid function.

具体来说,我们作为轻量级的重排,将任务描述 D 和最新的交互 h t - 1 h_{t - 1 }作为查询和对过去每次交互的分数。

blocks.en:
Much as a token being generated in an autoregressive model is conditioned on preceding tokens, we regard the upcoming decision as conditioned on the past interactions.
Following this analogy, the task description D D and the latest interaction h t − 1 h_{t-1} jointly constitute the query for the relevance estimator, while each past interaction h i h_{i} serves as a key and its canonical image I i I_{i} as the corresponding value.
The relevance score p i ( t ) p_{i}^{(t)} is therefore a measure of the dependence of the upcoming decision on the information in h i h_{i} .
Each interaction is scored in isolation, so that its relevance is not diluted by the presence of other interactions in long-horizon tasks.
As the query is renewed with the latest interaction at every step, the relevance of each past interaction evolves with the progress of the task.

根据这一类比,任务描述D和最新的交互 h t − 1 h_{t-1} 共同构成对相关性估计器的查询,而以往的每一个交互 h i h_{i} 都起到关键的作用,并且它的能动图像 I i_{i} 作为相应的值.

每一次互动都是孤立地得分的,因此其相关性不会被长期任务中存在的其他互动所淡化.
随着每一步都有最新的互动来更新查询,过去每次互动的相关性随任务的进展而变化.

blocks.en: 4.4 Learning Relevance Estimation and Resolution Mapping
blocks.zh: 4.4 学习相关性估计和分辨率绘图

blocks.en:
We learn the relevance estimator f θ f_{\theta} and the mapping g ϕ g_{\phi} in two stages, namely relevance supervision ( Stage I ) and resolution reinforcement ( Stage II ).
Relevance supervision distills the relevance judgments from a teacher model into the estimator.
Resolution reinforcement then calibrates the relevance estimator and the resolution mapping to preserve the agent’s original decisions with fewer visual tokens.

我们分两个阶段学习了相关性估计器f-f-theta}和绘图g-g-_{\phi},即相关性监督(第一阶段)和分辨率强化(第二阶段)。
相关性监督将相关判断从教师模型中提炼出到估算器.
分辨率强化后会校正相关性估计器和分辨率映射,以用较少的视觉符号来保存代理人的原始决定.

blocks.en:
A pretrained reranker such as Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B [ 45 ] typically judges whether a passage matches a query in semantic meaning, whereas Resolution as Attention requires the extent to which the upcoming decision depends on each past interaction.
These two notions of relevance are related yet distinct, as a past interaction may be semantically related to the query but exert little influence on the decision, and vice versa.
We therefore distill such decision relevance from a teacher model into the lightweight estimator f θ f_{\theta} .

To obtain supervision signals that reflect decision relevance, we collect decision histories from high-scoring agent trajectories on long-horizon tasks.
At every step of these trajectories, the teacher model is given the task description D D and the history ℋ t \mathcal{H}_{t} , anticipates the next action, and rates the dependence p ^ i ( t ) ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] \hat{p}_{i}^{(t)}\in[0,1] of the anticipated action on each past interaction.

Relevance supervision grounds the estimator in decision relevance before resolution is introduced.
Such grounding is crucial, as the effectiveness of resolution reinforcement builds upon the ability of the relevance estimator to single out interactions on which the upcoming decision depends.

Decision relevance indicates the importance of each past interaction, yet the resolution each interaction requires is determined by the perceptual capability of the agent.
We therefore calibrate the estimator and the resolution mapping jointly with reinforcement learning, guided by feedback from the frozen agent on how faithfully it preserves its original decisions.

blocks.en: 5 Experiments
blocks.zh: 5个实验

blocks.en:
In this section, we conduct extensive experiments to evaluate Resolution as Attention .
First, we describe the experimental setup ( Sec. 5.1 ) and present the main results ( Sec. 5.2 ).
Second, we ablate its components and training stages ( Secs. 5.3 and 5.4 ).
Third, we analyze the cost weight λ \lambda ( Sec. 5.5 ) and its complementarity with existing memory management methods ( Sec. 5.6 ).

首先,我们描述实验设置(第5.1节)并介绍主要结果(第5.2节)。
其次,我们放弃其组成部分和培训阶段(第5.3和第5.4节)。
第三,我们分析成本权重 \\ lambda(第5.5节)及其与现有内存管理方法的互补性(第5.6节)。

blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
We primarily evaluate Resolution as Attention on ClawGym-Bench [ 1 ] , a long-horizon benchmark comprising 200 agentic tasks across six categories.
Following its official evaluation protocol, we score each task by combining code-based verification with rubric-based assessment and report the hybrid average score.
To quantify token cost, we report the average values of two metrics across all tasks: (1) the total number of history tokens consumed and (2) the peak number of history tokens in a single agent call.
We further evaluate Resolution as Attention on AppWorld [ 28 ] in Sec. C.1 .
blocks.zh:
我们主要评价决议是关注ClawGym-Bench [1],这是一个由六类200项代理任务组成的长范围基准。
根据其官方评价协议,我们通过将基于代码的核查与基于标题的评估相结合来对每项任务进行评分,并报告混合平均分.
为了量化代币成本,我们报告所有任务中两个公尺的平均值:(1) 所消耗的历史代币的总数;和(2) 一个代理调用中的历史代币的峰值.
我们进一步评价决议作为对AppWorld[28] Sec.C.1中的关注。

blocks.en:
We compare Resolution as Attention with representative baselines that expose the memory to the agent through textual or visual perception.
Textual baselines retain varying portions of the history.
Specifically, Vanilla exposes the full history to the agent, FIFO [ 40 ] restricts access to the five most recent rounds of the history, and LongLLMLingua [ 8 ] provides a pruned textual context conditioned on the task description and the latest round.
Visual baselines instead present the history as rendered images.
OCR-Memory [ 11 ] preserves the resolution of the five most recent rounds while halving that of earlier rounds, whereas AgentOCR [ 4 ] allows the agent to select a global compression factor for the rendered history.
All methods run within the OpenClaw framework [ 24 ] , with further implementation details provided in Sec. B.2 .
blocks.zh:
我们把分辨率比作“注意”和“通过文字或视觉感知使内存暴露给代理人的代表性基线”。
文字基线保留了历史的不同部分。
具体地说,香草公司向代理商暴露了完整的历史,FIFO[40]限制进入了最近五轮历史,而LongLLMLingua[8]提供了以任务描述和最新一轮为条件的被打压的文字上下文.
相反,可视基线显示的历史是成像。
OCR-Memory [11] 保留了最近五轮的解析度,同时将前几轮的解析度减半,而AgentOCR [4] 则允许代理为被渲染的历史选择一个全局压缩系数.
所有方法都在OpenClaw框架内运行[24],进一步的实施细节载于Sec.B.2.

blocks.en:
We train Resolution as Attention with Qwen-3.8-27B [ 20 ] as the frozen agent and initialize the relevance estimator from Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B [ 45 ] .
For relevance supervision, we use 12,000 decision histories collected from 1,853 ClawGym training tasks, with interaction-level relevance ratings generated by Qwen-3.8-27B.
Resolution reinforcement then jointly optimizes the estimator and the resolution mapping for 150 updates.
At inference time, each past interaction is resized to its predicted scale, except for the latest one, which forms the query and is kept as text.
To assess cross-agent transfer, we additionally deploy the trained module on Qwen-3.6-27B [ 19 ] and Kimi-K3 [ 26 ] without further fine-tuning.
All evaluation backbones remain frozen and use a temperature of 0.
Further details are provided in Appendix A .

blocks.en: 5.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 5.2 主要成果

blocks.en:
We report the comprehensive results of Resolution as Attention and all baselines on ClawGym-Bench in Tab. 1 .
Across all backbones, Resolution as Attention consistently achieves the lowest tokens per task while maintaining task performance comparable to Vanilla, reducing the history tokens per task by 57.5%, 51.5%, and 55.9% on Qwen-3.8-27B, Qwen-3.6-27B, and Kimi-K3, respectively.
In comparison, FIFO, LongLLMLingua, and AgentOCR consume 26.2% to 82.6% more tokens per task than Resolution as Attention , while achieving lower average scores on all backbones.
Since Resolution as Attention is trained only with Qwen-3.8-27B, the consistent gains on the other two backbones without further fine-tuning demonstrate its transferability and robustness as a perception layer across different agents.
Notably, OCR-Memory reaches slightly lower peak tokens than Resolution as Attention on Qwen-3.6-27B and Kimi-K3, as its recency-based downscaling compresses earlier interactions regardless of their relevance.
However, this can obscure critical details, causing OCR-Memory to take 7.0% and 14.0% more steps and consume 14.4% and 10.7% more tokens per task than Resolution as Attention on these two backbones.
Moreover, with a 0.6B estimator and canonical images rendered only once, relevance estimation and rendering account for only 2.51% of the end-to-end latency, as detailed in Sec. C.2 .

blocks.en: 5.3 Ablation on Relevance Estimation and Resolution-Controlled Rendering
blocks.zh: 5.3 关于相关性估计和由决议控制的制作的说明

blocks.en:
We ablate the two components of Resolution as Attention with Qwen-3.8-27B and report the results in Tab. 2 .
For relevance estimation, we remove the estimator and render all past interactions at a uniform scale s s .
Decreasing s s from 1.00 to 0.70 reduces the tokens per task from 47.8K to 36.2K at the cost of a drop in average score from 77.22 to 75.81, as critical details become illegible at a uniformly low resolution.
In contrast, Resolution as Attention adjusts the resolution of each interaction according to its relevance, achieving a higher average score of 78.69 with 38.2K tokens per task.
It is worth noting that, although rendering at full resolution reduces the tokens per task of Vanilla by 46.8%, it lowers the average score by 1.01 points, whereas relevance estimation further reduces the tokens by 20.1% while preserving a score comparable to Vanilla.
For resolution-controlled rendering, we replace rendered images with textual content, keeping the top- k k past interactions ranked by the relevance estimator as text and discarding the rest.
Increasing k k from 3 to 5 raises the average score from 77.63 to 78.98 but inflates the tokens per task from 42.6K to 61.1K, as every retained interaction is kept in full text.
By comparison, Resolution as Attention achieves an average score of 78.69 with only 38.2K tokens per task.
The slight performance advantage at k = 5 k=5 stems from recognition errors introduced when reading text from rendered images.

We ablate the contribution of each training stage and report the results in Fig. 3 .
As shown in Fig. 3(a) , without training, Resolution as Attention scores 76.16 using about 49K tokens per task. Figure 3(b) reveals that its predicted scales concentrate near full resolution, with a median scale of 0.98, as semantic similarity barely reflects the relevance of interactions to the decision.
Stage I trains the relevance estimator with relevance supervision, reducing the tokens to about 34K but reaching a score of only 77.12.

Stage II calibrates the relevance estimator and the resolution mapping with reinforcement learning, raising the score to 77.92 at the cost of over 44K tokens.

blocks.en:
We further integrate Resolution as Attention with three representative memory management methods, namely ACON [ 10 ] , A-MEM [ 38 ] , and observation masking [ 13 ] , which manage the history through summarization, retrieval, and masking, respectively.
As shown in Tab. 3 , Resolution as Attention reduces their tokens per task by 22.5% to 54.1% without compromising task performance.
Moreover, Resolution as Attention alone already consumes fewer tokens per task than any of the three methods.
These methods determine what information remains available to the agent, whereas Resolution as Attention controls the resolution at which the information is perceived.
These results demonstrate that memory perception complements existing memory management, further reducing token consumption.

这些方法决定了代理人仍然掌握哪些信息,而作为注意的决议则控制着了解信息的决议。
这些结果表明,内存感知补充了现有的内存管理,进一步减少了象征性消耗.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We introduce Resolution as Attention , a memory perception mechanism that renders past interactions as images and scales their resolution based on their relevance to the upcoming decision.
By adapting the perceptual granularity of each interaction, RAA reduces token consumption by up to 57.5% without compromising task performance.
When integrated with existing memory management methods, it further saves up to 54.1% of tokens.
These results highlight memory perception as a dimension of agent memory complementary to retrieval and compression techniques.
blocks.zh:
我们提出“决议”作为关注,这是一种记忆感知机制,它使过去的相互作用成为图像,并根据它们与即将作出的决定的相关性来衡量其分辨率。
RAA通过调整每次相互作用的感知颗粒性,使象征性消费减少高达57.5%而不损害任务性能.
与现有内存管理方法相整合后,会进一步节约高达54.1%的代币.
这些结果凸显出内存感知是代理内存的一个维度,是对检索和压缩技术的补充.

blocks.en: Appendix A Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 附录A 实施情况

blocks.en: This section provides the detailed implementation of Resolution as Attention , including the training data preparation ( Sec. A.1 ), two training stages ( Secs. A.2 and A.3 ), and the rendering configuration ( Sec. A.4 ).
blocks.zh: 本节详细介绍了作为关注的决议的执行情况,包括培训数据编制(Sec.A.1)、两个培训阶段(Secs.A.2和A.3)以及制作配置(Sec.A.4)。

blocks.en: A.1 Training Data Preparation
blocks.zh: A.1 编制培训数据

blocks.en:
We use trajectories collected from ClawGym [ 1 ] training tasks to construct training samples for both Stage I and Stage II .
Each sample contains the task description and the interaction history before the agent’s next decision.
blocks.zh:
我们利用从ClawGym[1]培训任务中收集的轨迹为第一阶段和第二阶段设计培训样本。
每个样本都包含任务描述和代理商下个决定前的交互历史.

blocks.en:
As shown in Tab. 4 , we collect training trajectories from two sources.
The official ClawGym-Trajectory dataset, generated by MiniMax-M2.5 [ 14 ] and GLM-5.1 [ 5 ] , provides 7,900 samples for Stage I, while our self-collected trajectories, generated by Qwen-3.8-27B [ 20 ] within the OpenClaw framework [ 24 ] , provide 4,100 samples for Stage I and 2,400 for Stage II.
We keep trajectories that complete with a code verification score of at least 0.8, and discard samples with an empty history or empty tool calls.
This ensures that the training samples are of high quality and provide sufficient context for the estimator.
blocks.zh:
如塔布所显示. 4,我们从两个来源收集训练轨迹.
由MiniMax-M2.5[14]和GLM-5.1[5]生成的官方ClawGym-Trajectory数据集为第一阶段提供了7,900个样本,而由Quen-3.8-27B[20]在OpenClaw框架内生成的自取轨迹则为第一阶段提供了4,100个样本,为第二阶段提供了2,400个样本.
我们保留了至少0.8的代码验证分数完成的轨迹,并丢弃有空历史或空工具呼叫的样本.
这确保培训样本质量高,并为估算者提供足够的背景。

blocks.en:
Stage II trajectories are collected separately from those used in Stage I.
The training tasks are disjoint from the 200 evaluation tasks in ClawGym-Bench.
blocks.zh:
第二阶段的轨迹与第一阶段所用的轨迹分开收集。
培训任务与ClawGym-Bench的200项评价任务脱节。

blocks.en: A.2 Relevance Supervision
blocks.zh: A.2 相关性监督

blocks.en:
We use Qwen-3.8-27B as the teacher model with a temperature of 0 and low-effort thinking.
For each sample, the teacher receives the task description, the tool definitions, and the interaction history.
It then anticipates the next action, rating each past interaction independently from 0 to 1 according to how much the anticipated action depends on it.
Each output is validated to contain exactly one score in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] for every past interaction, and invalid outputs are regenerated. The scoring prompt used to generate the ratings is provided in Appendix G .
blocks.zh:
我们使用Quen-3.8-27B作为教师模型,温度为0,低功率思维.
对于每个样本,老师都会收到任务描述,工具定义,以及互动历史.
然后,它预期下一个行动,根据预期行动取决于多少,将过去每次互动从0到1独立评分。
每个输出被验证为在[0, 1] [0, 1] 中准确包含一个分数,用于每次以往的交互,无效输出会被再生成. 用来产生评分的评分提示载于附录G。

blocks.en:
We initialize the estimator from Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B [ 45 ] and fully fine-tune it on the teacher ratings.
Since a single round may issue multiple tool calls, we treat each action-observation pair as an interaction and include the shared reasoning of its round.
To counter the imbalanced distribution of teacher ratings, we weight the mean squared error with label distribution smoothing [ 41 ] . Specifically, it divides [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] into 50 bins and weights each label by the inverse square root of its smoothed density.
We train the estimator for one epoch using AdamW with a learning rate of 10 − 5 10^{-5} , a weight decay of 0.01, a cosine schedule with 5% warmup, and a batch size of 16.
blocks.zh:
我们从Qwen3-Rranker-0.6B[45]初始化了估计器,并充分微调了教师的收视率.
由于一回合可能发出多个工具呼叫,我们把每个动作-观察对作为互动,并包括其回合的共同推理.
为了解决教师评级分布不平衡的问题,我们用标签分布平滑来权衡平均平方错误[41]. 具体地说,它将[0, 1] [0, 1] 分为50个宾箱,并用其平滑密度的倒方根来给每个标签分量.
我们使用 AdamW 来训练一个时代的估测器, 学习率为 10 - 5 10 - 5 , 体重衰减为 0.01 , 余弦计时为 5% 的热量, 批量大小为 16 个。

blocks.en: A.3 Resolution Reinforcement
blocks.zh: A.3 加强决议

blocks.en:
For each sample, the estimator first assigns deterministic scales to all past interactions.
We then group these interactions into low, medium, and high scale bands (split at 1 / 3 1/3 and 2 / 3 2/3 ), randomly select one band, and sample an interaction h i h_{i} from it.
This balances the reinforcement learning exploration space by covering low, medium, and high resolutions.
Only the selected interaction h i h_{i} receives K = 8 K=8 sampled scales with τ = 0.5 \tau=0.5 , while all other interactions keep their deterministic scales.
blocks.zh:
对于每个样本,估计器首先为所有以往的相互作用指定了决定尺度.
然后将这些相互作用分为低、中和高尺度波段(在1 / 3 1/3和2 / 3 2/3分出),随机选择一个波段,并从中抽取一个交互h i h_{i}。
这通过覆盖低、中和高分辨率来平衡强化学习探索空间。
只有所选的交互h i h_{i}接收到K=8 K=8的采样比例尺并有\\\ tau=0.5,而所有其他的交互都保持了它们的定型比例尺.

blocks.en:
We initialize the estimator from the Stage I fine-tuned checkpoint and the mapping with k = 8 k=8 and b = 0.4 b=0.4 .
We train for 150 updates with 16 samples per update using AdamW, with learning rates of 10 − 6 10^{-6} for the estimator and 10 − 3 10^{-3} for the mapping, and a cost weight of λ = 5 × 10 − 4 \lambda=5\times 10^{-4} .
The training takes about 22 hours on eight A100 GPUs, seven of which serve the frozen agent for scoring while the remaining one trains the estimator and the mapping.
blocks.zh:
我们从第一阶段微调检查站初始化估计器,并绘制出K=8克=8和b=0.4b=0.4的地图。
使用 AdamW 进行150次更新,每更新16个样本,估算器的学习率为 10 - 6 10 - 6 - 6 5 ,绘图器的学习率为 10 - 3 10 - 3 10 - 3 ,成本重量为 5 × 10 - 4 \ lambda = 5\ 10 - 4 }。
8个A100GPU的训练大约需要22小时,其中7个为被冻结的代理人打分,而其余一个则训练估计器和绘图.

blocks.en: A.4 Rendering Configuration
blocks.zh: A.4 渲染配置

blocks.en:
We render the action, observation, and reasoning of each past interaction into separate canonical images.
The action and observation of an interaction share the same scale, while the shared reasoning of one round uses the largest scale among its interactions.
For the main experiments, the renderer uses the Verdana font at 13 px with a line height of 15 px and a maximum width of 1,120 px.
Line breaks are collapsed to save space.
Each image is resized from its canonical version by the same factor along both dimensions with Lanczos resampling, and is padded to the visual-token grid of the backbone model, namely 32 px for Qwen-3.8-27B and Qwen-3.6-27B [ 19 ] , and 28 px for Kimi-K3 [ 26 ] .
blocks.zh:
我们把过去每次互动的动作、观察和推理变成单独的犬科图像。
一种相互作用的动作和观察具有相同的尺度,而一种回合的共同推理则使用其相互作用中最大的尺度。
对于主要实验,渲染器在13px使用Verdana字体,线高为15px,最大宽为1,120px.
换行符倒塌以节省空间.
每个图像由与兰克佐斯再生相伴的两维相伴的同因子从舟形版本中调整出大小,并被加入到主干模型的可视相接网格上,即:32px为Quen-3.8-27B和Quen-3.6-27B [19];28px为Kimi-K3 [26].

blocks.en: Appendix B Evaluation Details
blocks.zh: 附录B 评价详情

blocks.en: This section describes the evaluation protocol on ClawGym-Bench ( Sec. B.1 ) and the implementation of all baselines ( Sec. B.2 ).
blocks.zh: 本节介绍关于ClawGym-Bench(第B.1节)的评价议定书和所有基线的执行情况(第B.2节)。

blocks.en: B.1 Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: B.1 评价议定书

blocks.en:
ClawGym-Bench contains 200 tasks across six categories.
Following the official protocol, 154 tasks are scored by code verification alone, while the other 46 combine code verification and rubric-based assessment, using GPT-5.4 as the rubric judge.
All agents remain frozen with a temperature of 0.
History tokens count the textual and visual tokens of the interaction history.
For visual tokens, each rendered image is padded to the visual-token grid of the backbone.
blocks.zh:
ClawGym-Bench包含分6个类别200项任务.
在正式协议之后,154个任务仅通过代码校验而得分,而其他46个任务则将代码校验与以名词为主的评估相结合,使用GPT-5.4作为名词判事.
所有特工仍被冻结,温度为0.
历史符号计算了互动历史的文字和视觉符号.
对于视觉符号,每个被渲染出的形象被加入到主干线的可视相接网格上.

blocks.en: B.2 Baseline Implementation
blocks.zh: B.2 基线执行情况

blocks.en:
We directly use the official implementation of AgentOCR [ 4 ] and adapt it to support the native tool protocol of OpenClaw.
The agent outputs a compression factor c ≥ 1 c\geq 1 to control the compression of the interaction history.
blocks.zh:
我们直接使用 AgentOCR [4] 的正式执行,并修改后支持OpenClaw的本土工具协议.
代理输出压缩因子 c\\ 1 c\ geq 1 来控制交互历史的压缩 。

blocks.en: Since the official implementation of OCR-Memory [ 11 ] is not publicly available, we adapt its recency-based resolution policy to the history presented to the agent, using the same rendering pipeline as RAA .
blocks.zh: 由于OCR-Memory [11] 的正式实施并不公开,因此我们根据向代理人介绍的历史调整其基于反应的解析政策,使用与RAA相同的渲染管道.

blocks.en:
We use the official implementation of LongLLMLingua [ 8 ] with Llama-2-7B [ 27 ] as the scoring model.
When the history exceeds 8,192 tokens, LongLLMLingua prunes the history to a retention rate of 0.3.
blocks.zh:
我们使用以Llama-2-7B[27]为评分模式的LongLLMLingua[8]正式实施.
当历史超过8,192个令牌时,LongLLMLingua将历史推向了0.3.

blocks.en: We implement the First-In-First-Out (FIFO) policy [ 40 ] by preserving the five most recent rounds as text and discarding all older interactions.
blocks.zh: 我们通过保留最近五轮作为文本并放弃所有旧的相互作用,执行 " 第一批第一 " 政策。

blocks.en:
We use the official history optimizer of ACON [ 10 ] without further guideline optimization.
Qwen-3.8-27B summarizes the history once it exceeds 8,192 tokens.
When combined with RAA , the summary is rendered as an image whose resolution is assigned by the relevance estimator.
blocks.zh:
我们使用ACON[10]的官方历史优化器,而不进一步优化准则.
文-3.8-27 (中文(简体) ). B总结历史一旦超过8,192个令牌.
当与RAA结合时,摘要是作为相关估计者指定其分辨率的图像而提供的。

blocks.en:
Following its official implementation [ 38 ] , we store each earlier round as a memory note.
Qwen-3.8-27B constructs the notes, and all-MiniLM-L6-v2 [ 31 ] embeds them for retrieval.
When combined with RAA , the retrieved notes are rendered at resolutions assigned by the estimator.
blocks.zh:
在正式实施之后[38],我们把先前的每个回合作为记忆笔记存储.
文-3.8-27 (中文(简体) ). B构建了笔记,而All-MiniLM-L6-v2[31]嵌入了这些笔记以供取回.
当与RAA结合时,取回的笔记根据估计者指定的决议来提供.

blocks.en:
Following The Complexity Trap [ 13 ] , we mask the observations of all but the five most recent rounds.
In the integration with RAA , masking is applied before relevance estimation, so that the estimator only considers unmasked content.
blocks.zh:
继"复杂陷阱"[13]之后,我们掩盖了除了最近五轮外的所有其他观察.
在与RAA的整合中,口罩在相关估计之前被应用,因此估计者只考虑未做口罩的内容.

blocks.zh: (b) 步骤和象征性费用

blocks.en:
Figure 5 : Trade-off between performance and token cost on AppWorld using Qwen-3.8-27B.
Each method varies its perception parameter, namely the font size f f for RAA , the window size k k for FIFO, the retention rate r r for LongLLMLingua, and the number n n of full-resolution recent rounds for OCR-Memory.
AgentOCR (48.81% TGC at 117.5K tokens) is omitted since it lies outside the plotted range and is dominated by all other methods.
blocks.zh:
图5:使用Quen-3.8-27B在AppWorld上的性能和象征性成本之间的取舍。
每种方法都会改变其感知参数,即RAA的字体大小为ff;FIFO的窗口大小为kk;LongLLMLingua的保留率为r;OCR-Memory的全分辨率近代回合数为n.
AgentOCR(48.81%的TGC值为117.5K令牌)被省略了,因为它位于被规划的范围之外,并且被所有其他方法所支配.

blocks.en:
To assess the generality of Resolution as Attention , we further evaluate it on AppWorld [ 28 ] , a benchmark consisting of 168 tasks that require writing code to operate simulated apps.
Since AppWorld is code-heavy, we use a larger monospaced font to render the interaction memory.
The relevance estimator and resolution mapping trained on ClawGym are directly reused without fine-tuning.
blocks.zh:
为了评估分辨率作为注意力的通用性,我们在AppWorld[28]上进一步评价了它,这个基准由168个任务组成,需要写出代码来操作模拟应用.
由于AppWorld是代码重的,我们使用更大的单相距字体来渲染交互内存.
在ClawGym上接受过相关估计和分辨率绘图培训,但无需微调即可直接再利用。

blocks.en:
As shown in Tab. 5 , RAA achieves the lowest tokens per task across all backbones, reducing history-token consumption relative to Vanilla by 29.8%, 25.6%, and 52.7% on Qwen-3.8-27B, Qwen-3.6-27B, and Kimi-K3, respectively.
It also attains the highest TGC among the evaluated memory management methods, with 5.95, 8.33, and 1.19 points below Vanilla, respectively.
These score drops are due to the fact that RAA perception depends on the Optical Character Recognition (OCR) capabilities of the backbone, and AppWorld requires accurate reading of rendered code.
Specifically, the score drop is more significant on Qwen-3.6-27B than on Qwen-3.8-27B, and is smallest on Kimi-K3, consistent with their performance on text-rich visual benchmarks such as OmniDocBench [ 15 ] and CharXiv [ 33 ] .
blocks.zh:
如塔布所显示. 5,RAA在所有骨干区实现每个任务的最低信使,在Quen-3.8-27B,Quen-3.6-27B和Kimi-K3上分别将历史记录与香草相比的消费减少29.8%,25.6%和52.7%.
它还在评价的内存管理方法中达到最高的TGC,分别低于香草5.95分,8.33分和1.19分.
这些分数下降的原因是RAA感知依赖于主干线的光学字符识别(OCR)能力,而AppWorld要求精确地读取已渲染的代码.
具体来说,积分下降在Quen-3.6-27B上比在Quen-3.8-27B上更为显著,在Kimi-K3上则最小,与他们在OmniDoc Bench [15]和CharXiv [33]等富于文字的视觉基准上的表现一致.

blocks.en:
To examine the trade-off between performance and token consumption as well as the effect of font size, we vary the font size of Resolution as Attention without retraining, together with the perception-controlling parameters of the baselines.
As shown by the Pareto fronts in Fig. 5 , RAA achieves the best trade-off between performance and tokens, while keeping its number of steps on par with Vanilla.
At a font size of 17, it matches the TGC score of LongLLMLingua with a 40% retention rate, while consuming around 40% fewer tokens.
Increasing the font size from 17 to 21 steadily improves its score from 77.98% to 83.93%, with tokens per task growing from 61.3K to 78.8K, which is still over 20% lower than that of Vanilla.
Overall, RAA consistently outperforms all baselines in the trade-off between performance and token consumption.
Its perception is grounded in the OCR capability of the backbone.
blocks.zh:
为了审查性能和象征性消费之间的取舍以及字体大小的影响,我们用不作再培训的方式,将分辨率的字体大小与基线的感知控制参数相区别。
如图5的Pareto战线所示,RAA在表现和象征之间实现了最佳的取舍,同时保持了与Vanilla同等的步数.
在17个字体大小时,它与LongLLMLingua的TGC分数相匹配,保留率为40%,同时消耗了约40%的代币.
将字体大小从17个增加到21个稳步提高,其分数从77.98%提高到83.93%,每个任务的代币从61.3K增加到78.8K,仍比香草低20%以上.
总体而言,RAA在性能和象征性消费之间的取舍方面一贯超过所有基线。
它的认知基于骨干部的OCR能力.

blocks.zh: C.2 延迟分析

blocks.zh: (a) 端到端延迟

All times are averaged over 200 tasks.

blocks.en:
We measure the end-to-end latency of RAA and Vanilla on ClawGym-Bench using Qwen-3.8-27B.
As shown in Fig. 6(a) , RAA takes about 326 seconds per task, only 4.3% longer than Vanilla, where relevance estimation and rendering together account for 2.51% of the end-to-end time.
However, the reduction in history tokens does not translate into lower latency. As shown in Fig. 6(b) , this is because the decoding process dominates the inference time of both methods.
Instead, the shorter history context of RAA reduces the peak KV cache occupied by the history by 47.8%.
blocks.zh:
我们使用Quen-3.8-27B在ClawGym-Bench上测量RAA和Vanilla的端到端的延迟.
如图6(a)所示,RAA每次任务耗时约326秒,仅比"香草"长4.3%,而"香草"的关联性估计和渲染共占到端到端时间的2.51%.
然而,历史象征物的减少并没有转化为较低的延迟. 如图6(b)所示,这是因为两种方法的推断时间以解码过程为主.
相反,RAA较短的历史背景将被历史占用的峰值KV缓存减少了47.8%.

blocks.en: C.3 Analysis of Perception Modalities
blocks.zh: C.3 认识方式分析

blocks.en: (a) Performance and number of steps
blocks.zh: (a) 业绩和步骤数目

blocks.en: (b) Token consumption
blocks.zh: (b) 消费

blocks.en:
Figure 7 : Comparison with budget-matched text perception on ClawGym-Bench using Qwen-3.8-27B. Budget-Matched Text keeps the relevance estimator and resolution mapping of RAA , but replaces visual rendering with LongLLMLingua pruning.
Each interaction retains the fraction of tokens determined by RAA .
blocks.zh:
图7:使用Quen-3.8-27B与ClawGym-Bench的预算对应文本感想进行比较。 预算 文本保留了RAA的关联估计和分辨率映射,但以LongLLMLingua pruning取代了视觉渲染.
每一次互动都保留RAA决定的符分.

blocks.en:
A natural question is whether textual perception can match RAA when given the same interaction-level perception budget.
To this end, we construct Budget-Matched Text , which keeps the relevance estimator and resolution mapping of RAA but presents each interaction as text pruned by LongLLMLingua.
Each interaction therefore retains the same fraction of tokens as determined by RAA .
As shown in Fig. 7(b) , Budget-Matched Text reaches similar peak tokens compared to RAA .
However, as shown in Fig. 7(a) , under the aligned budget, Budget-Matched Text takes 14% more steps, which raises its tokens per task by 33%.
Meanwhile, its average score of 77.72 remains 0.97 points below that of RAA .
We attribute this difference in part to how the two representations accommodate a reduced budget.
Textual pruning removes discrete tokens, potentially discarding exact values or other details that the agent must recover through additional interactions.
Visual resolution instead provides a continuously adjustable means of controlling perceptual detail.
This allows less relevant interactions to remain coarsely readable and convey the essential information.
blocks.zh:
一个自然的问题是,如果考虑到相同的互动水平的认知预算,文本感知能否匹配RAA.
为此,我们构建了“预算编译文本 ” , 该文本保留了RAA的关联性估计和分辨率映射,但将每个互动作为由LongLLLMLingua所浏览的文本来呈现。
因此,每个相互作用都保留了RAA确定的同分部分的符号.
如图7(b)所示,与RAA相比,经预算调整的文本达到类似的峰值标志。
然而,如图7(a)所示,在统一预算下,预算调整后的案文将增加14%,使每项任务增加33%。
同时,其77.72的平均得分仍比RAA低0.97分.
我们将此差异部分归因于这两个代表如何顾及预算的削减。
文字修补可以去除离散的符号,有可能丢弃精确的值或其他细节,代理人必须通过额外的相互作用来恢复.
相反,视觉分辨率提供了一个持续可调整的手段来控制视觉细节。
这使得不太相关的相互作用能够保持粗糙的可读性并传递基本信息。

blocks.en: Memory management for agents has primarily addressed two problems, namely which past information should be recalled and which information should remain after condensation . Resolution as Attention instead focuses on another dimension of agent memory, namely at what granularity the information should be perceived . Table 6 summarizes the differences. We discuss each family of methods below.
blocks.zh: 代理人记忆管理主要解决了两个问题,即应当回顾哪些过去的信息,哪些信息应当在收缩后保留。 作为“注意”的决议则侧重于代理人记忆的另一个方面,即信息应具有何种颗粒性。 表6汇总了这些差异。 我们讨论下面的每一个方法

blocks.en:
Retrieval-based methods keep past interactions in an external memory and recall the relevant episodes into the context when needed.
MemGPT [ 16 ] organizes memory into a hierarchy that the agent manages through function calls, and A-MEM [ 38 ] links memory notes and retrieves them by semantic relevance.
OCR-Memory [ 11 ] renders past trajectories into images that serve as an index for a trained OCR retriever, which locates relevant segments and returns their original text to the agent.
Our experiments adopt only its recency-based resolution policy as a baseline ( Sec. B.2 ), which is the component directly comparable to RAA .
Despite their effectiveness, these methods primarily control which episodes are available to the agent. Retrieved episodes are brought into the context, while unretrieved ones remain inaccessible.
As a result, each episode is read either in full or not at all, and retrieval alone does not determine how finely it is perceived. RAA addresses this complementary problem by adjusting the resolution at which each interaction is perceived according to its relevance to the upcoming decision.
It can therefore be applied to either the full interaction history or a retrieved subset, providing adaptive perceptual fidelity as a new dimension of agent memory.
blocks.zh:
以检索为基础的方法将过去的互动保留在外部记忆中,并在需要时将相关事件回顾到上下文中.
MemGPT [16] 通过函数调用将内存组织成一个由代理管理的结构,而A-MEM [38] 链接内存注释并通过语义相关性检索.
OCR-Memory [11] 将过去的轨迹制作成图像,作为训练有素的OCR检索器的索引,该检索器定位相关段并返回其原始文本给代理.
我们的实验只采用其基于理性的解析政策作为基线(Sec.B.2.),这是与RAA直接相仿的组成部分。
尽管这些方法很有效,但这些方法主要控制代理人可以利用的几起事件。 检索到的事件被带入上下文,而未检索到的事件仍然无法进入。
因此,每集要么被完整地读取,要么根本不被读取,而仅靠检索并不能决定其感想有多细微. RAA通过调整分辨率来解决这一互补问题,在这种分辨率中,每次互动都根据其与即将作出的决定的相关性来看待。
因此,它可以适用于完整的相互作用历史或检索的子集,提供适应性的感知忠诚作为代理记忆的新方面。

blocks.en:
Textual compression methods condense the history in the text space by summarizing, masking, or pruning its content.
ACON [ 10 ] summarizes the history with compression guidelines once its length exceeds a threshold, while observation masking and FIFO remove earlier observations or interactions based on recency.
LongLLMLingua [ 8 ] prunes the tokens of a long-context prompt according to their perplexity under a small language model, and assigns lower compression ratios to more relevant documents.
Although these methods effectively condense the context, they decide which content remains, and the removed content is permanently discarded.
As a result, details that become relevant later are lost. RAA instead retains all interactions and adjusts the perceptual fidelity through resolution.
Our experiments in Sec. C.3 further show that, under the same per-interaction budget, resolution supports adaptive perception more effectively than textual pruning, which takes 14% more steps and scores 0.97 points lower.
These methods determine what content remains, while RAA determines how finely it is perceived and can thus complement them on the retained content.
blocks.zh:
文字压缩方法通过归纳,遮掩,或穿透其内容来收缩文字空间中的历史.
ACON [10]在长度超过阈值后会用压缩准则来总结历史,而观测遮掩和FIFO则会根据回放性去除更早的观测或相互作用.
LongLLMLingua [8] pruns a long-context protests 根据其在小语言模型下的迷惑性,将一个长文本的活字提示来表示,并将更低的压缩比分配给更相关的文档.
虽然这些方法有效地收缩了上下文,但它们决定了哪些内容还保留下来,被移除的内容被永久地丢弃.
因此,后来变得相关的细节被丢失. 相反,RAA保留了所有的相互作用,并通过解析来调整知觉忠诚.
我们在Sec. C.3的实验进一步表明,在相同的每次交互预算下,分辨率支持适应感比文字穿透更有效,这需要增加14%的步数,分数更低0.97分.
这些方法决定了所保留的内容,而RAA则决定了如何精确地看待这些内容,从而在保留的内容上加以补充。

blocks.en:
Optical compression methods render text into images, which can be read through fewer visual tokens.
DeepSeek-OCR [ 34 ] and Glyph [ 2 ] train vision-language models to read text rendered into images, with the compression ratio determined by the pre-defined resolution and the rendering configuration.
AgentOCR [ 4 ] extends this to agent memory by training the agent to output a compression factor that applies to the entire history, and VERA [ 25 ] downsamples older chunks of the history by recency.
MemOCR [ 23 ] trains a model to rewrite its memory into markdown-style text that emphasizes important information through layout.
While achieving substantial compression, most of these methods treat optical rendering primarily as a means of compression, where the compression ratio is either fixed, shared across the entire history, or determined by recency.
MemOCR varies the emphasis of content, but it does so by rewriting the entire memory, which leads to permanent loss of information. RAA instead treats resolution as a means of perception, assigning each interaction its own resolution according to its relevance to the upcoming decision.
This introduces perceptual fidelity as a distinct dimension of agent memory, enabling interaction-wise, decision-aware, and non-destructive perception through dynamically adjustable resolution, without training the agent.
blocks.zh:
光学压缩方法将文本制成图像,可以通过较少的视觉符号来读取.
DeepSeek-OCR [34]和Glyph [2] 列车视觉语言模型来读取被渲染成图像的文本,压缩比由预定义的分辨率和渲染配置决定.
AgentOCR [4] 通过训练代理输出一个适用于整个历史的压缩因子,将这一点延伸至代理内存,而VERA [25] 则通过调整来对历史中更古老的块进行下标.
MemOCR [23] 训练出一个模型来将内存重写为以打分为主的文字,通过布局强调重要信息.
在实现实质性压缩的同时,这些方法大多主要将光学渲染作为压缩手段,压缩比要么固定,在整个历史中共享,要么由再生决定.
MemOCR对内容的强调度有所不同,但它通过重写整个内存来做到这一点,这导致了信息的永久丢失. 反之,RAA将分辨率视为一种感知手段,根据每种相互作用与即将作出的决定的相关性来分配自己的分辨率。
这引入了知觉忠诚作为代理记忆的一个独特方面,通过动态可调整的解析,而无需训练代理,从而能够进行交互,决策意识和无损感知.

blocks.en: Appendix F Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 附录F 限制和未来的工作

blocks.en: Although RAA introduces perception as an orthogonal dimension of memory management, several aspects warrant discussion, which we present below along with potential directions for future work.
blocks.zh: 虽然RAA将观念引入记忆管理的一个正统层面,但有几个方面值得讨论,下文将介绍这些方面以及未来工作的潜在方向。

blocks.en:
RAA learns relevance by encouraging decision consistency with the agent under the full textual history.
This objective prioritizes preserving the agent’s performance while reducing the cost of memory perception, rather than improving its underlying decision-making ability.
However, consistency with the reference agent does not guarantee task correctness and may preserve its mistakes.
Future work could incorporate task-level rewards to learn perception policies that both reduce token consumption and support more effective decisions.
blocks.zh:
RAA通过鼓励在全文历史中与代理商一致的决定来学习相关性.
这一目标将保持代理人的性能放在优先地位,同时降低记忆感知成本,而不是提高其基本决策能力。
然而,与参考代理人的一致性并不能保证任务的正确性并可能保留其错误.
今后的工作可包括任务层面的奖励,以学习既能减少象征性消费又能支持更有效决策的认知政策。

blocks.en:
RAA reassigns the resolution of past interactions at each step, potentially changing previously rendered content and limiting prefix-cache reuse.
However, this limitation is shared by memory management methods that modify earlier context, such as LongLLMLingua, AgentOCR, and observation masking.
Future work could explore cache-aware perception policies that balance token consumption with prefix stability.
blocks.zh:
RAA在每个步骤上重新指定过去相互作用的解析度,可能改变先前被渲染的内容并限制前缀切换再用.
然而,这种局限性被改变更早上下文的内存管理方法所共享,如LongLLMLingua,AgentOCR,和观察口罩.
今后的工作可以探索缓存感知政策,使象征性消费与前缀稳定性保持平衡。

blocks.en:
RAA relies on the backbone’s OCR capabilities to interpret rendered history.
Our experiments show that the font size provides an effective approach to balancing readability and token consumption without retraining the relevance estimator.
However, we do not further analyze other rendering configurations, such as the typeface, layout, and syntax highlighting.
Future work could explore rendering configurations that adapt to the content and the backbone.
blocks.zh:
RAA依靠骨干OCR能力解释历史。
我们的实验表明,字体尺寸提供了一种有效的方法,在不重新评价相关估计因素的情况下,平衡可读性和象征性消费。
然而,我们并没有进一步分析其他渲染配置,例如类型面,布局,和语法突出化.
今后的工作可以探索适应内容和主干线的渲染配置.
